articles.title: Postgres Recovery: Verified Channels over Support Tickets (With Prior Enrollment)
articles.excerpt: Prefer a second verified channel for account recovery when it was enrolled before the lockout and still meets the account's assurance requirements; send cases without that evidence to a restricted sup…
articles.body: Prefer a second verified channel for account recovery when it was enrolled before the lockout and still meets the account's assurance requirements; send cases without that evidence to a restricted support review. For a logistics password-reset flow, the deciding question is whether recovery can establish sufficient confidence to replace a credential without handing a stolen session a fresh route back in. TL;DR: A previously verified second channel is the preferred routine path. A support ticket is the exception path when that channel is unavailable, disputed, or too weak for the requested access. Neither path should silently preserve existing sessions or treat successful delivery of a message as proof that the entire account is safe.

articles.body: Công khai: Mình đang làm việc tại ipvora, một dịch vụ proxy dân cư. Bài viết tập trung vào cách kiểm tra kỹ thuật, dùng được với bất kỳ nhà cung cấp nào hỗ trợ HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5. Bạn đã cấu hình Playwright đi qua một proxy dân cư, mở https://ipinfo.io/json và thấy đúng IP Việt Nam, Mỹ hay Nhật — rồi kết luận trình duyệt đã đi hết qua proxy. IP trên một trang kiểm tra mới chỉ phản ánh kênh HTTP(S) của trang đó. Ba kênh khác vẫn có thể đi ra ngoài proxy: DNS (máy bạn tự phân giải tên miền), WebRTC (kênh UDP/ICE), và IPv6 (nếu máy có IPv6 trong khi proxy chỉ nhận IPv4).

articles.title: Large AI-Generated Image PNG Upload Timeout: Node.js Multipart vs Single PUT
articles.excerpt: Use multipart upload for large AI-generated images or batches when a single PUT starts timing out; keep single PUT for files that finish reliably. The deciding constraint is not PNG versus WebP. It is…
articles.body: Use multipart upload for large AI-generated images or batches when a single PUT starts timing out; keep single PUT for files that finish reliably. The deciding constraint is not PNG versus WebP. It is whether a failed request forces the entire artifact across the network again. That choice solves only transport. A media training pipeline also needs a reproducible rule for retention and deletion. Persist multipart state in the application database, resume finished parts after a retry, and make every terminal path call either complete or abort. Lifecycle policy is a backstop measured in days, not a cleanup worker for abandoned hourly jobs.

articles.title: Who turned the W upside down? Why Cassiopeia won't sit still
articles.excerpt: The queen in the northern night sky is supposedly one of the easiest constellations to recognize — you just look for a W. Or is that an M?
articles.body: Some constellations are like old friends. You know them well, they're always there, and they never seem to change. A case in point is Cassiopeia, the queen. Its beautiful name comes from Greek mythology — the mother of Andromeda — and its shape is said to represent a queen sitting on a throne. To a stargazer, Cassiopeia is best known as a prominent northern constellation shaped like the letter W. It's easy to find — look north, find five reasonably bright stars making a W, congratulate yourself on finding Cassiopeia and use it to get somewhere more interesting. It's so often a signpost, not a destination. But look north a few hours after dark this month, and you'll notice the W has gone.
